summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for Pain Map. 15/15 pytest backend tests pass covering auth (register/login/logout/me/duplicate/wrong-pass/google-session validation), diary CRUD + stats, reviews list/create (seeded + auth-gated), and AI assistant /api/assistant/chat. Frontend Playwright run successfully exercised: register -> auto-redirect to /dashboard, diagnostics wizard (age -> body-map region selection with Next-disabled gating -> descriptors -> severity slider=6 producing Yellow result banner) -> save-to-diary -> entry visible on dashboard, reviews add-review modal submit, floating AI assistant open/send, theme toggle (dark), and protected-route redirect (/diagnostics and /dashboard -> /login when cookies cleared).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan context manager.

CORS allow_origins falls back to http://localhost:3000 if FRONTEND_URL env missing - with allow_credentials=True this could break prod if env is unset; prefer failing fast or using REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL-derived origin.
/api/assistant/chat is not auth-gated - any unauthenticated caller can consume Emergent LLM quota. Recommend requiring get_current_user.

Password strength: /api/auth/register does not enforce a min-length (test spec expects 'password under 6 chars shows an error' - currently only enforced client-side; backend accepts any non-empty password).
No rate limiting / lockout on /api/auth/login (brute-force risk).

Password min-length (spec: <6 chars should error) is only enforced on the frontend; backend currently accepts short passwords - flag if main agent wants backend-side validation.
